messages:
alex_cs: FYI — AcmeCorp just opened a ticket: our latency dashboard (team:payments) lost p95/p99 lines after the 03:17 deploy. They can still see avg/p50 but tails are gone. Screenshot attached: https://redwood-attachments/ak3l2/screenshot.png

sre_oncall: Thanks — can you paste the dashboard permalink and org id? Is this only for AcmeCorp or visible on org-level view too?

alex_cs: permalink: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/teams/payments?org=acmecorp. Org-level still shows lines, but account-level view for AcmeCorp hides them. Reported by customer at 03:30.

sre_oncall: Hmm, that smells like a tag/label transform or a filter applied during query. Were there any metric transform changes in the deploy? @deploy-bot do you have the change list?

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-27T03:17Z by lina — rolled out collectors: metric-transform-v2, ingest-hotfix-7. Rollout status: success.

devon: I hit the same panel in prod-priv and p95/p99 are missing if I switch the panel to "group by org_id" but appear if grouped by "service". So it's likely the transform that maps org tags got renamed.

lina: I pushed a transform yesterday to normalize org tag to `org_id` from `org`. It was supposed to add alias only, not replace. The config snippet: ```yaml
metrics.transforms:
  - match: 
      metric: "request_latency_ms"
    actions:
      - rename_label: {from: "org", to: "org_id", mode: "alias"}
```

sre_oncall: If alias mode failed it could have dropped the original `org` label for some series, which would break dashboards that filter on `org`. Can you check the transform logs in /var/log/metric-transform/ for 03:15-03:20?

lina: grabbing logs now. paste: ```
2026-03-27T03:16:22Z INFO apply_transform: rename_label succeeded for 42k series
2026-03-27T03:16:23Z WARN apply_transform: alias mode not supported for legacy protobuf payloads, falling back to replace
```

sre_oncall: There it is — fallback changed label name, so queries filtered on `org` returned no series. That explains why org-scoped dashboards hide p95/p99 (the percentile functions need the series to exist). But why only tails? Why avg/p50 still show?

devon: Percentile panels use a different series aggregation path in the backend (quantile-aggregator) that resolves series by label set. If the label set changed, the historical aggregation keys won't match and quantiles render empty. Avg/p50 panels use rollup metrics that were generated with the new label, or they fallback to precomputed metrics.

sre_oncall: Short term workaround: edit the dashboard panel query to use `org_id` instead of `org` or remove the org filter to restore visibility. Longer term: revert transform or re-run in true alias mode.

alex_cs: Customer wants ETA and whether this affected billing or SLA alerts. Can we confirm if alerting rules triggered incorrectly?

lina: Alerts that were scoped by `org` would not have fired for AcmeCorp during the window 03:17-03:40. I will roll back the transform to restore `org` label and then re-run alias patch in a small canary. Rolling back now.

sre_oncall: Please also kick off a rescan to repopulate percentile aggregation keys for the short window if possible — otherwise customers will see gaps in p95/p99 history. Command: `bin/agg-rescan --metrics request_latency_ms --start 2026-03-27T03:15 --end 2026-03-27T03:45 --by org,service`

lina: rescan queued (job 7721). ETA ~12m. I’ll post when done.

devon: Verified fix on my end after rollback — p95/p99 returned for AcmeCorp account-level panel.

alex_cs: Passing to AcmeCorp support contact with note: root cause metric-transform fallback replaced `org` label; we rolled back and queued rescan to repair percentile aggregates. Next update in 15m. :+1:

sre_oncall: Follow-up items: add unit test for alias mode with legacy protobufs, add dashboard check in release test (make sure p95/p99 present for org-scoped views), and add circuit-breaker if transform falls back to replace mode.

lina: filed tickets T-4523, T-4524, T-4525. Closing thread once rescan completes.
